title: Multilingual Bias Detection and Mitigation for Indian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Binary classification of Wikipedia sentences as biased or unbiased based on the Neutral Point of View (NPOV) guidelines using multilingual Transformer encoders (MuRIL, InfoXLM, mDeBERTa). Mitigation is evaluated as a text style transfer task using encoder-decoder models (mT5, IndicBART, mT0), measured by text generation metrics (BLEU, METEOR, chrF, BERT-Score), a custom Normalized Accuracy (NAcc) metric for debiasing, and human evaluation for fluency and meaning preservation.
